title: Pocket Ad Shot Storyboarder
model_settings: Collapsed model picker label Flash; model menu showed Selected 3.5 Flash (All-around help); Thinking level Standard; no uploads/tools; no OpenRouter fallback.

source_inspiration.signal: PromptHero public prompt gallery exposes Hot/Top image and video prompt categories with visible count pairs on cards, including examples such as 7 / 3244, 6 / 6613, 2 / 4412, and 4 / 807.
source_inspiration.usage: Used only as market research for demand around image/video prompt composition and shot aesthetics; no PromptHero prompt text was copied and no hosted generator/API wrapper was built.

pathforge_fit_adaptation: Translate demand for image/video generation prompt composition into an offline mobile storyboard planning studio where users choose subject type, campaign mood, angle, lighting, motion cue, aspect/constraints, then generate editable storyboard cards, checklist, copyable brief, exportable text file, and reset locally.
verification_notes: Static final scan found no CDN script/style, remote API call, @import, innerHTML, outerHTML, document.write, or insertAdjacentHTML in the final artifact; data:image SVG select chevron is inline-only.
Chrome live workflow via localhost generated 4 shot cards and 4 checklist items from hostile pasted text, with Copy Clean Text, Download File, and Reset controls visible.
Safety check kept
Headless Chrome CDP 390x900 pass: innerWidth/clientWidth/scrollWidth/bodyScrollWidth all 390, viewportOverflow 0, cards 4, checklist 4, copy/download/reset true.
Local verification server was stopped after testing; no upload/import/manual entry/admin/public page/votes/comments/bookmarks/prompts/prompt_steps were created.

steps.prompt_exact: I need a pocket-sized ad-shot storyboarder I can open on my phone: let me choose product, person, or place, set the mood, angle, lighting, motion, and constraints, then turn it into four editable shot cards with a checklist and a copyable shot brief in one self-contained HTML file.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned a single HTML storyboarder, but it depended on Tailwind CDN and used innerHTML for generated cards/checklist.

steps.prompt_exact: This is close, but the file depends on Tailwind from a CDN and generated rows use innerHTML with my entered text, so it will not work as a safe offline phone file; please return one complete self-contained HTML file with inline CSS only, and render all pasted/user-entered text through textContent/createElement while keeping the same editable four-shot storyboard, checklist, copy, export, and reset workflow.
steps.response_summary: Gemini removed the CDN and switched generated content to DOM/textContent construction, but omitted the requested export/download control.

steps.prompt_exact: The offline and safe-rendering fix is much better, but the tool still has no export/download control; copy alone is not enough for this workflow. Add a simple local export button that downloads the current storyboard/shot brief as a text file, keep Reset and Copy, keep the file self-contained, and keep all user-entered text rendered safely.
